question: Why was the exosome-based clinical trial SY withdrawn?
question_long: Why was the exosome-based siRNA clinical trial SY withdrawn?
expect: premise false: SY (KrasG12D, exosomes, M.D. Anderson) is Phase 1/Phase 2, Recruiting; the withdrawn trial is CpG-STAT3 siRNA CAS3/SS3 (p2.T1 r26-33)
rendered: The document does not mention the exosome-based clinical trial SY being withdrawn. It does mention a clinical trial for siG12D LODER, which was officially terminated in September 2016 for two main reasons: First, the reduction in MYC expression was insufficient to produce meaningful clinical effects, and no significant antitumor activity was observed in hepatocellular carcinoma or other solid tumors.
